name: Cold Caster

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: Reference-only: Learn Ray of Frost, or a Wizard cantrip if already known, using the ability raised by this feat. Once per turn, a hit dealing Cold applies −1d4 to the target’s next save before your next turn ends.
